items.title: Binance says fake job interview led to $6.3 billion crypto heist

items.title: Google dismantles massive botnet hidden in Android TV boxes
items.snippet: The overwhelming majority of the infected devices in the X.CPE botnet are Android TV set-top boxes, Google said, adding that they observed a number of other infected Android-based IoT devices, including telehealth devices, karaoke machines and digital signage devices.

items.why: Inventory Android-based connected devices and check how they are monitored and secured.

learn.explainer: LLMjacking is the hijacking of access to large language models. The item says these attacks can generate fraudulent cloud charges.
Autonomous warfare refers to the use of systems that can carry out some military functions with autonomy. The item lists it among developments shaping the Army's future.
Resilient timing means maintaining reliable time information for systems. The item describes a high-performance time server and interoperability platform designed for high-speed Ethernet networks.

analysis.headline: Exposure, access and strategic resilience
paragraphs: Today's cyber stories describe several paths to exposure: hijacked cloud AI use can create fraudulent charges, an attacker accessed WorkOS sales records, and a reported fake interview led to malware and a compromise of wallet infrastructure. The stories differ, but each makes access and the consequences of misuse relevant to defenders.

CISA's KEV addition is based on evidence of active exploitation, while the PowerSYSTEM Center snippet says successful exploitation could allow unauthorized actions. Together, they suggest a need to check advisory applicability and keep an eye on how systems and services are accessed. The supplied details do not establish a connection between these incidents.

The Ukraine stories frame security through costs, military capacity and domestic industry; the timing platform and satellite partnership add technical and industrial dimensions. For analysts, these are different scales of resilience. Watch for further advisory details and how the stated strategic arguments develop, without treating claims or proposals as settled outcomes.
takeaways: Review access, usage and charges for cloud AI services.
Check CISA advisories against your affected systems.
Track how Ukraine's security debate links support and domestic capacity.
